source_clauses.verbatim: Pressing it should send a signal to the machine
when I take my foot off it must return to its resting position on its own every time
It should not move if something brushes against it sideways

requirements.statement_verbatim: Pressing it should send a signal to the machine
requirements.observable_verbatim: Pressing it should send a signal to the machine

requirements.statement_verbatim: when I take my foot off it must return to its resting position on its own every time
requirements.observable_verbatim: when I take my foot off it must return to its resting position on its own every time

requirements.statement_verbatim: It should not move if something brushes against it sideways
requirements.observable_verbatim: It should not move if something brushes against it sideways

freedoms.decision: Mechanism of returning to resting position

ambiguities.statement: What constitutes 'move' in 'should not move'? Does it mean no displacement, no activation, or something else?

assumptions.statement: The pedal is operated by foot pressure.
assumptions.why: The request says 'pressing it' and 'take my foot off'.
assumptions.would_be_invalidated_by: If the pedal is operated by something else.

assumptions.statement: The resting position is the position when not pressed.
assumptions.why: Implied by 'return to its resting position'.
assumptions.would_be_invalidated_by: If a different reference is specified.

assumptions.statement: The signal is sent to the machine.
assumptions.why: The request states 'send a signal to the machine'.
assumptions.would_be_invalidated_by: If the machine is not the intended recipient.
